original_ai_output.title_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州部署移动厕所以终结露天排便
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州政府在该州13个地方政府辖区内投放移动厕所，以应对露天排便问题。州政府宣布对露天排便零容忍，并将其称为严重的公共卫生紧急事件。环境、固体矿产与矿业专员Margaret Elayo在11月19日世界厕所日前的媒体吹风会上作出上述表示。

key_facts.fact: 纳萨拉瓦州政府在该州13个地方政府辖区投放移动厕所以应对露天排便
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nasarawa State Government has introduced mobile toilets, which are to be distributed to specific locations across the 13 Local Government Areas of the state in order to tackle the surge of open defecation.

key_facts.fact: 州政府宣布对露天排便零容忍，并将其称为严重公共卫生紧急事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The state government declared zero tolerance for open defecation, describing the practice as not only an embarrassment, but as a severe public health emergency.

key_facts.fact: 专员Margaret Elayo在11月19日世界厕所日前的媒体吹风会上作出上述表示
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Margaret Elayo, stated this on Thursday during a media briefing ahead of the World Toilet Day, slated for November 19, 2026.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
移动厕所的具体投放地点与数量未在报道中说明
